correctness.rationale: Exact polar integration gives the Gamma(n+1,1) eigenvalue formula and trace 2cR/sqrt(t). Uniform Berry--Esseen on n=N+O(sqrt N) proves the two-error-function profile. Gamma Chernoff bounds supply uniform exponentially summable off-window tails, supporting all continuous trace functions dominated near zero by u^p, including quasi-Schatten p<1. Strict unimodality establishes counting and norm. Fubini and the N(0,2) Gaussian difference density give the explicit erfc trace coefficient. Numerical checks replay actual normalized eigenvalue formulas; finite tests are supplementary to the proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-domain two-term anti-Wick asymptotics describe separated interfaces; the natural unresolved scale is when two jumps approach within the coherent-state smoothing width. The theorem gives the complete spectral transition, all positive quasi-Schatten powers and an exact trace crossover that is strictly increasing and saturates at the independent-edge constant. This is a structural operator asymptotic with a motivated continuum of geometries, not a single arbitrary parameter slice or a restatement of the Gamma CLT.
